name: lever calf stretch (plate loaded)
description: A calf stretch on a plate-loaded lever machine, using the platform to push the heel down and lengthen the lower leg.
instructions: Set up on the machine and place the ball of one foot on the platform with the heel free.
Keep your knee straight and stand tall.
Let the heel sink down until you feel a stretch in the calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then release slowly.
